directions.name: Fight First / Context Lens
directions.compositionLaw: The live scene owns the screen; one compact lens follows the selected actor, region, or blocker.
directions.primaryScreen: Runtime Match with Studio tools entering as task-specific lenses instead of permanent columns.
directions.signatureMove: Changing mode recomposes around the same live scene, and every diagnostic is visually tethered to the exact actor, stage layer, asset, or evidence record it describes.
directions.navigation: Three product modes in a quiet top rail; Studio tasks in a commandable lens switcher.
directions.mobileStrategy: True scene-first viewport with a bottom task sheet and thumb-reachable runtime controls.
directions.risk: Dense technical work may require more transitions because most detail is contextual.

directions.name: Evidence Split / Cause and Repair
directions.compositionLaw: One selected blocker drives a two-part workspace: cause on the left, repair and proof on the right.
directions.primaryScreen: Studio Workbench centered on the source → runtime → evidence → build trust chain, with a restrained live preview strip.
directions.signatureMove: A single vertical causal thread connects the active source fact, runtime consequence, missing evidence, repair action, and export impact.
directions.navigation: The production chain is primary; Character, Stage, Debug, and Modules open as evidence sources within it.
directions.mobileStrategy: Cause and repair become ordered chapters with a persistent selected-blocker header.
directions.risk: Runtime play feels less central and needs an explicit scene-first handoff.

directions.name: Scene Desk / Layered Workbench
directions.compositionLaw: A large object workspace is surrounded only by the tree, inspector, or timeline needed by the current selection.
directions.primaryScreen: Creator Studio with a large live scene/object canvas, a source/object tree, a contextual inspector, and an optional trace timeline.
directions.signatureMove: Selecting a fighter, frame, stage layer, asset, evidence record, or module transforms the same inspector and tethers related trace/build facts without changing the mental model.
directions.navigation: Objects and production stages replace eight equal-looking dashboards; stable routes remain addressable beneath the new shell.
directions.mobileStrategy: Canvas or data artifact first; tree and inspector become mutually exclusive sheets, timeline becomes a scrub strip.
directions.risk: Requires the most disciplined component and state-selection seam during migration.
